applies_why: This judge text addresses whether Jeremiah 22:30 counts as an unanswered witness against a link, and it declines to count it because the pressed curse limb was dropped.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: Not counting it obeys this rule: reading 1, the judge is not counting Jeremiah 22:30 once the curse limb was dropped, so no quoted press sentence is needed; reading 2, any reference to C4's press counts the verse and requires the quoted press sentence.
why: The judge declines to count Jeremiah 22:30 as a broken-link witness after the curse limb was dropped, and non-counting is expressly permitted, so no quoted press sentence is required.
